input.title: iOS update from N-1 to Submission #50 resets save to level 1 / 500 coins
input.description:
Found on the QA regression runbook's update-path check for the ZM store push (ZOM-570). Source: Brian's "Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135" doc, Sep 30.

**Device / OS:** iPhone 13, iOS 18.6
**Source build:** N-1 store version (App Store), updated to iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50)

**What happens:** after the update the save comes back at level 1 with 500 coins. Before the update the account was on level 212 with 18,400 coins. Relaunching doesn't bring the progress back.

**Repro:**
1. Install the N-1 build from the App Store
2. Play past level 200
3. Install TestFlight 50 (iOS Submission #50) over it
4. Launch

**Other update rows on the same run:** iOS N-2 → #50 passed. Android N-1 → #135 and N-2 → #135 passed (level, coins and unlocks kept).

Lost progress/coins is a blocker under the ZM submission rules. The runbook also says any UPDATE-column failure blocks the release. This is the update-path failure class the runbook warns about (the June 2025 progression loss).

## QA gate blockers (Vincent, Oct 1)

QA call: **NO-GO** on Android #135 / iOS #50 as cut. Full register: ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50".

- ZOM-581: iOS update N-1 → #50 resets the save to level 1 / 500 coins (runbook update-path FAIL, new ticket)
- ZOM-573: Collect&Win 5th chest claim crashes (#135)
- ZOM-578: tutorial stuck at step 3 on a fresh install (#135)
- ZOM-576: Season Pass premium tier claim drops the booster bundle (#50)
- ZOM-560: abandoned pack purchase doesn't grant the win streak freezer time (#135)
- ZOM-483: new-install infinite lives cut from 50 to 30 min after relaunch (#135)
- ZOM-546: endless refill drains the board, run can't continue (#135 / #50)
- ZOM-554: quitting mid tornado leaves the next level unplayable until force-quit (#50)
- ZOM-449: low-end Android freeze on cold start into level 3 (#135)
- ZOM-559: Samsung home-out → victory screen freeze, force-quit (seen on #133, not re-tested on #135)
- DES-313: level 214 can't be completed, only 2 of 3 jars spawn (#135)
- ZOM-435: still stuck on the trophy path after a fast double claim on #135 (Done, fix in the build)
- ZOM-569: Season Pass double-open / empty screen. Fix a61cb2b landed after the Started lines, so not in either candidate
- ZOM-567: Zombie Lane chests don't land on prod. Backend #36 is deployed, but the chest-row data load hasn't run on prod

input.message:
QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50: **NO-GO** as cut. There are 14 blockers on ZOM-570.

One correction to "matrix green": Brian's fresh-install rows are green, but the update-path run failed. iOS N-1 → #50 brought a level 212 / 18,400-coin save back at level 1 / 500 coins. The runbook says any update-column failure blocks. I filed it as ZOM-581. The other three update rows pass.

Blockers:
• ZOM-581: iOS N-1 update wipes progression
• ZOM-573: Collect&Win 5th chest crash
• ZOM-578: tutorial step 3 stuck on fresh install
• ZOM-576: SP premium tier drops the booster bundle
• ZOM-560: abandoned pack doesn't grant freezer time
• ZOM-483: new-install infinite lives cut to 30 min
• ZOM-546: endless refill drains the board
• ZOM-554: quit mid tornado leaves the next level unplayable
• ZOM-449: low-end cold-start freeze
• ZOM-559: Samsung victory screen freeze (seen on #133, still needs a #135 check on a Samsung)
• DES-313: level 214 can't be finished
• ZOM-435: trophy path stuck again on #135 (Leonard)
• ZOM-569: SP double-open fix landed at 21:36, after both Started lines, so it's not in either build
• ZOM-567: backend #36 is deployed, but the chest data load hasn't run on prod (Arthur's holding it), so chests still don't land

Also: 21 known issues, 11 fixed, and the rest no call. Full register is in the ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50".
